title: First-Return Relief on Northgate Cash Reversals
content:
*How many returns has the member made in the past year?* Under the consumer return reversal schedule of Northgate Rewards and Northgate+ Memberships, the answer sets a relief on the reversal for a member who rarely returns merchandise. The returns counted are every return recorded on the member's Northgate orders on Northgate Store and Online Orders dated within the twelve whole calendar months before today, that is, dated on a day from which fewer than twelve whole calendar months have passed by today.

| Returns so counted | Added to the relief fraction |
|---|---|
| the return is the only one | 0.1 |
| the return is one of exactly two | 0.05 |
| three or more | nothing |

**Window boundary (hypothetical "today" of 20 November 2032)**

| Return date | Counted in the window |
|---|---|
| 21 November 2031 | yes |
| 20 November 2031 | no, twelve whole calendar months have passed |

**Hypothetical illustration.** A member whose only return in that window is the one being reversed adds 0.1 to the relief fraction; with one other return in the window, 0.05.
